answer: Inter-arrival rhythm gating. Each identity must show a stable arrival-time distribution across its first N actions; agents whose spacing sits at a population summit of near-simultaneous bursts get throttled until variance normalizes. A lone whisper of traffic from many fresh keys at once trips the gate, since organic demand produces ragged gaps. Attackers must either run each fake identity through real timed warmup or scatter a plume of staggered launches, multiplying wall-clock time and orchestration overhead per identity.
